GOOGLE-CONTACTS-LOCATION-FGS-API37.summary: If your app targets API 37 or later, request contacts (READ_CONTACTS) only when the Contact Picker can't cover core features, and declare it. Use the location button with the onlyForLocationButton manifest flag for location-button scope. Use the Geofence API, not a foreground service, for geofencing. From 27 October 2026, Play Console pre-review checks flag contacts and location issues.

GOOGLE-TECH-QUALITY-FEB-2027.title: Meet new code and memory optimization standards
GOOGLE-TECH-QUALITY-FEB-2027.summary: Google says that from February 2027 (exact day not published), your app must have at least 25 percent coverage across optimization, shrinking and obfuscation with a tool such as R8. It must not keep images (bitmaps) in memory when not visible, and must stay within memory bad-behavior thresholds. Falling short affects visibility and publishing options.

GOOGLE-RESTORE-CREDENTIALS-APR-2027.title: Keep users signed in on new Android devices
GOOGLE-RESTORE-CREDENTIALS-APR-2027.summary: From April 2027 (exact day not published), if your app lets people sign in, whether sign-in is optional or required, it must restore their sign-in when they move to a new Android device, using the Restore Credentials API. Games are currently not included.

GOOGLE-ANON-CHAT-CHILD-SAFETY-2026.title: Block minors from anonymous chat apps
GOOGLE-ANON-CHAT-CHILD-SAFETY-2026.summary: If your app is mainly for random or anonymous chat with strangers, use Play Console tools to block minors and don't target children under Families. You must also publish child-safety standards, offer in-app reporting, remove child sexual abuse material and name a child-safety contact.

APPLE-SOCIAL-MEDIA-DECLARATION-GATE.title: Declare social media features before submitting updates
APPLE-SOCIAL-MEDIA-DECLARATION-GATE.summary: Starting September 2026 (no exact day published), you must say whether your app or game has social media features before you can submit a new version or update, or notarize for other marketplaces. Saying yes gives it a 13+ minimum rating and puts it in Apple's Social Media screen time category. To serve under-13 users you need the Declared Age Range API.

EU-DMA-UNIFIED-TERMS-2026.title: New EU fees and payment options for apps
EU-DMA-UNIFIED-TERMS-2026.summary: From 1 October 2026, a 5 percent commission on digital sales in apps distributed outside the App Store replaces the per-install Core Technology Fee, and the Initial Acquisition Fee and Store Services Fee end. You may offer other payment options alongside Apple In-App Purchase. Seven alternative criteria widen who can distribute through marketplaces and the web. Accept Apple's Attachment 14.

APPLE-ADPLA-ATTACHMENT-12-BRAZIL.title: Accept new terms for alternative distribution in Brazil
APPLE-ADPLA-ATTACHMENT-12-BRAZIL.summary: By 6 July 2026, every Apple Developer Program member had to accept the updated developer agreement. Until you do, you can't send new submissions. From iOS 26.5, in Brazil only, you may distribute through other app marketplaces, run your own marketplace, and take payments for digital goods outside Apple In-App Purchase.

APPLE-REGION-AGE-RATINGS-AU-VN-2026.title: Age rating changes in Australia and Vietnam
APPLE-REGION-AGE-RATINGS-AU-VN-2026.summary: From 18 June 2026, the 15+ rating is no longer available in Australia, and apps that had it move to 16+. Apps available in Vietnam need their own Vietnam age rating that follows local rules. Check your age rating for each storefront in App Store Connect.

GOOGLE-PLAY-BILLING-V8-EXISTING-2027.title: Update to Play Billing Library 8, then 9
GOOGLE-PLAY-BILLING-V8-EXISTING-2027.summary: All published apps must use Play Billing Library 8 by 31 August 2027 (1 November 2027 with an extension) and version 9 by 31 August 2028 (1 November 2028 with an extension). New submissions needed version 8 by 31 August 2026 (1 November 2026 with an extension). Published versions on older libraries can still process purchases until their own deadline.

US-ADA-TITLE-II-WCAG-2027.title: Government apps must meet accessibility standard
US-ADA-TITLE-II-WCAG-2027.summary: If a state or local government serving 50,000 or more people provides or makes your app available, the app must meet the accessibility standard WCAG 2.1 Level AA by 26 April 2027. The earlier date of 24 April 2026 was pushed back. The duty reaches you as a commercial developer through the contract or licensing chain.

US-ADA-TITLE-II-WCAG-2028.title: Accessible apps for small public bodies by 2028
US-ADA-TITLE-II-WCAG-2028.summary: If your app is for a public body serving fewer than 50,000 people, or for any special district government, it must meet the WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standard by 26 April 2028. This deadline has been pushed back to that date.

US-HHS-504-WCAG-2027.title: Health-funded organizations' apps must be accessible
US-HHS-504-WCAG-2027.summary: If an organization with 15 or more employees gets federal funding from the US health department (HHS) and provides a mobile app, directly or through a contract or licensing arrangement, the app must meet the WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standard by 11 May 2027. This replaces the earlier date of 11 May 2026.

US-HHS-504-WCAG-2028.title: More time for small HHS-funded organisations
US-HHS-504-WCAG-2028.summary: If your organisation gets US health department (HHS) funding and has fewer than 15 employees, your website and mobile apps must meet the WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standard. Your deadline has moved from 10 May 2027 to 10 May 2028.

US-FTC-COPPA-AGE-VERIFICATION-POLICY.title: Collect age data safely for age checks
US-FTC-COPPA-AGE-VERIFICATION-POLICY.summary: For general or mixed-audience apps, collecting and using age data to check ages won't risk COPPA enforcement, but only if you use it solely to work out age, keep it as briefly as possible, vet any third parties, tell parents and children, and secure it. This holds until final COPPA rule changes are published or the policy is withdrawn.

UK-DUAA-COMPLAINTS-PROCESS-2026.title: Set up a data protection complaints process
UK-DUAA-COMPLAINTS-PROCESS-2026.summary: You need a way for people to complain about how you handle their personal data. Acknowledge each complaint within 30 days and respond without undue delay.

UK-ICO-STORAGE-ACCESS-GUIDANCE-2026.title: Recheck all tracking, not only cookies
UK-ICO-STORAGE-ACCESS-GUIDANCE-2026.summary: Check every software kit (SDK) in your app, every tracking pixel and every device-fingerprinting call (identifying a device from its details) against the new guidance, not only cookies. Breaking the consent rules can now bring fines on the same scale as UK GDPR.

UK-DMCCA-SUBSCRIPTIONS-2027.title: New rules for auto-renewing subscriptions
UK-DMCCA-SUBSCRIPTIONS-2027.summary: Apps selling auto-renewing subscriptions to UK consumers must give key information before sign-up, send renewal reminders, offer two cooling-off periods, make cancelling easy and follow new refund rules. On 9 August 2026 the government said this starts in January 2027. A draft rule says 1 January 2027 but wasn't final on 14 November 2026, so that day is provisional.

UK-OSA-APP-STORES-REPORT-2027.title: Ofcom report on children's app store use
UK-OSA-APP-STORES-REPORT-2027.summary: Ofcom will publish its report on how children use app stores by January 2027. It will help the government decide whether app stores fall under the Online Safety Act. Nothing to do yet, just keep watching.

UK-UNDER16-SOCIAL-MEDIA-2027.title: Social apps must block under-16 users
UK-UNDER16-SOCIAL-MEDIA-2027.summary: Social apps must block under-16s. For 16 and 17 year olds, livestreaming, stranger contact, autoplay and personalised feeds are off by default, and notifications are off from midnight to 6am. AI romantic companion chatbots are 18 and over only. Rules are expected by end 2026, starting spring 2027. The exact day isn't published; 1 March 2027 is a placeholder.

EU-AI-ACT-MARKING-RETROFIT-2026.title: Mark AI content in existing generative features
EU-AI-ACT-MARKING-RETROFIT-2026.summary: If your generative AI for audio, images, video or text was already on the market before 2 August 2026, add machine-readable marks showing its content is AI-made. Stop running any AI system whose intended or reasonably foreseeable output is non-consensual intimate images or child sexual abuse material.

EU-PRODUCT-LIABILITY-SOFTWARE-2026.title: Standalone software and app updates count as products
EU-PRODUCT-LIABILITY-SOFTWARE-2026.summary: From 9 December 2026, standalone software and app updates count as products, so you can be held liable for harm they cause even if you weren't at fault. This covers anything you put on the market or into service on or after that date.

EU-DATA-ACT-SWITCHING-2027.title: Free switching and fairer older contracts
EU-DATA-ACT-SWITCHING-2027.summary: If you provide data processing services, you can't charge customers anything to switch away. Older open-ended or long-term contracts signed on or before 12 September 2025 must meet the unfair-terms rules by 12 September 2027.

EU-EIDAS-WALLET-ACCEPTANCE-2027.title: Accept the EU Digital Identity Wallet
EU-EIDAS-WALLET-ACCEPTANCE-2027.summary: Private businesses larger than micro or small size that rely on checking users' identity electronically, use strong login checks, and work in banking, finance, health, telecom, transport, energy, education or digital infrastructure must accept the EU Digital Identity Wallet when a user asks. This applies 36 months after the EU's implementing rules, a worked-out date of 24 December 2027.

EU-CSAM-EPRIVACY-DEROGATION-EXPIRY-2028.title: Permission for voluntary child abuse scanning ends
EU-CSAM-EPRIVACY-DEROGATION-EXPIRY-2028.summary: If your messaging or chat app doesn't run over phone numbers and voluntarily scans messages for child sexual abuse material, that scanning is allowed only until 3 April 2028. After that, you need the legal basis of the permanent Child Sexual Abuse Regulation, or you must stop scanning.

KR-PIPA-AMENDMENT-2026.title: Top executives become accountable for privacy
KR-PIPA-AMENDMENT-2026.summary: Name your CEO and legal representative as the people finally responsible for privacy. If your business is big enough to qualify, appoint a board-approved chief privacy officer. Expect punitive fines and wider rules on reporting data breaches.

KR-PIPA-MANDATORY-CERTIFICATION-2027.title: Large data handlers need official privacy certification
KR-PIPA-MANDATORY-CERTIFICATION-2027.summary: From 1 July 2027, any organisation or person handling personal information that meets a government threshold, based on revenue and how much personal data it processes, must hold the privacy regulator's certification or face a fine. The threshold wasn't published by 14 November 2026, so check whether your Korean operation falls under it once it is.

CN-AI-COMPANION-MINORS-2026.title: Protect minors in AI chat and companion apps
CN-AI-COMPANION-MINORS-2026.summary: If your chat, companion or roleplay app ships in China, identify users who are minors and switch them to minors mode automatically. Get a guardian's consent for under-14s, and never offer minors virtual companions or virtual family members.

SG-OSRAA-COMMENCEMENT-2026.title: Act on notices about serious online harms
SG-OSRAA-COMMENCEMENT-2026.summary: If your app is a platform, you must act when the Online Safety Commission notifies you about any of the five priority harms. More kinds of harm will be added over time, with no dates published yet.

IN-DPDPA-CONSENT-MANAGERS-2026.title: Get ready to work with consent managers
IN-DPDPA-CONSENT-MANAGERS-2026.summary: Registered consent managers (services that help people give and manage consent for their data) start one year after the rules were published on 13 November 2025. Be ready for your app to work with a registered consent manager before the next set of rules starts, 18 months after publication, on 13 May 2027.

JP-APPI-AMENDMENT-2028.title: Rework consent, children's and biometric data handling
JP-APPI-AMENDMENT-2028.summary: Update how you handle consent, children's data and biometric data. For under-16s, a parent or other legal guardian gives consent, gets notices and asks to stop use. This takes effect within two years of 17 July 2026, on a day set by cabinet order, as does a new surcharge system. Updated criminal penalties apply from 17 January 2027, a calculated date.

AU-ADS-CODE-AGE-ASSURANCE-2026.title: App stores must check age for adult apps
AU-ADS-CODE-AGE-ASSURANCE-2026.summary: App stores must check users' age and control access before letting anyone download or buy adult apps, starting six months after the Code began. The working-towards grace period ends and the first risk assessment is due that same day. This comes from an archived copy of eSafety pages last updated 19 May 2026, so re-check the live register.

AU-PRIVACY-ADM-DISCLOSURE-2026.title: Explain automated decisions in your privacy policy
AU-PRIVACY-ADM-DISCLOSURE-2026.summary: From 10 December 2026, if your app uses automated decision-making that significantly affects people's rights or interests, your privacy policy must say what kinds of personal information it uses and what decisions it makes.

AU-CHILDRENS-ONLINE-PRIVACY-CODE-2026.title: Binding children's privacy rules for online services
AU-CHILDRENS-ONLINE-PRIVACY-CODE-2026.summary: These children's privacy rules must be finalised and registered by 10 December 2026. They will bring binding children's privacy duties to social media, relevant electronic services and designated internet services. If your app falls into one of these groups, the rules will apply to you.

BR-DECRETO-12880-AGE-SIGNALS-2026.title: Stores must check age and block some apps
BR-DECRETO-12880-AGE-SIGNALS-2026.summary: App stores and operating systems must give a free age signal, ask age at sign-up, verify it by a regulator-approved method, allow disputes, get guardian approval and show age ratings before download. Stores must block gambling and lottery apps and apps without age checks.

BR-ANPD-ECA-ENFORCEMENT-2027.title: Age check rules start being actively enforced
BR-ANPD-ECA-ENFORCEMENT-2027.summary: Brazil's data protection authority (ANPD) publishes guidance and standards on age checks from August 2026, with time to adapt through November 2026. Active enforcement of the Digital ECA's age check duties starts in January 2027.

US-TAKE-IT-DOWN-ACT-2026.title: Remove reported intimate images within 48 hours
US-TAKE-IT-DOWN-ACT-2026.summary: If your app is a covered platform, offer a clear, easy-to-find way to report intimate images shared without consent. Remove reported content and known identical copies within 48 hours. The FTC began enforcing this on 19 May 2026.

US-CA-AB1043-AGE-SIGNAL-2027.title: Request and use the user's age signal
US-CA-AB1043-AGE-SIGNAL-2027.summary: From 1 January 2027, operating systems and app stores ask for a user's age at device setup and share an age range signal with apps through an API (a way for apps to request data). Your app must request this signal and use it.

US-CA-SB976-ADDICTIVE-FEEDS-2027.title: Treat users as minors unless age is checked
US-CA-SB976-ADDICTIVE-FEEDS-2027.summary: From 1 January 2027, treat every user as a minor unless age checks reasonably show otherwise. Do this before you show them an addictive feed or send notifications between midnight and 6am or during school hours. The Attorney General's rules on age checks are also due on 1 January 2027.

US-CA-AB56-WARNING-LABEL-2027.title: Show daily health warnings on social media
US-CA-AB56-WARNING-LABEL-2027.summary: If your app is a covered social media platform, from 1 January 2027 show the Surgeon General's black-box health warning every day when someone first uses it. Show it again after three hours of total use, then every hour after that.

US-CA-CPPA-ADMT-2027.title: Notices and opt-outs for automated decisions
US-CA-CPPA-ADMT-2027.summary: If your business uses automated decision-making technology in significant decisions, give notice, let people opt out and answer their access requests by 1 January 2027. Finish risk assessments for processing from before 2026 by 31 December 2027 and submit them by 1 April 2028. Cybersecurity audit certifications start 1 April 2028 for revenue above 100 million dollars.

US-CA-SB243-COMPANION-CHATBOT-2027.title: Yearly crisis reports for companion chatbots
US-CA-SB243-COMPANION-CHATBOT-2027.summary: If your app runs a companion chatbot, from 1 July 2027 you must report every year to the Office of Suicide Prevention on crisis referrals and your crisis protocols. This is on top of the disclosure and minor protection duties that already apply to you.

US-NY-SAFE-FOR-KIDS-2027.title: Limit feeds and night alerts for minors
US-NY-SAFE-FOR-KIDS-2027.summary: From 25 January 2027, don't show addictive feeds to minors or send them notifications between midnight and 6am unless a parent has given verifiable consent. Use certified age checks to tell who is a minor.

US-VT-AADC-2027.title: Strongest privacy settings by default for minors
US-VT-AADC-2027.summary: From 1 January 2027, if minors use your app, give them the most private settings by default, collect as little of their data as you can, and don't send them push notifications late at night. You'll also have to follow the attorney general's age-checking rules. Comments on those rules are due by 2 October 2026.

US-WA-HB2225-COMPANION-CHATBOT-2027.title: Disclosure and protections for AI companion chatbots
US-WA-HB2225-COMPANION-CHATBOT-2027.summary: From 1 January 2027, if your app offers an AI companion chatbot, you must show users the required chatbot disclosure and put protections in place for minors. That includes repeating the disclosure every hour while a minor keeps using it.

US-CO-SB26-051-AGE-SIGNAL-2028.title: Apps must check the device's age signal
US-CO-SB26-051-AGE-SIGNAL-2028.summary: Phone and computer system makers must ask for a user's age at account setup and give apps a live age signal (age-signal API). Your app must request that signal when it launches or when someone creates an account. This starts 1 July 2028, and applies to devices already in use by 1 January 2029.

US-OK-SB546-PRIVACY-2027.title: Let people access, fix and delete their data
US-OK-SB546-PRIVACY-2027.summary: From 1 January 2027, let people see, correct, delete and take a copy of their data. They must also be able to opt out of having it sold, used for targeted ads, or used for profiling.

APPLE-MULTISEAT-VOLUME-PURCHASING.title: Decide who can buy subscription seats in bulk
APPLE-MULTISEAT-VOLUME-PURCHASING.summary: Since 16 September 2026, subscriptions allow multi-seat purchases by default. Apple Business and Apple School Manager volume buying starts 22 October 2026, group purchases this winter. Before then, decide per auto-renewing subscription whether to allow it, and turn off or limit it across the App Store, Apple Business and Apple School Manager where it doesn't fit your pricing or access.

APPLE-AGE-RATING-LOCATION-DATING-2027.title: Answer new location and dating age rating questions
APPLE-AGE-RATING-LOCATION-DATING-2027.summary: From 16 November 2026, Apple's age rating questions ask whether your app lets people share their real-world location with another person or group, and whether it helps real people date or form relationships. Every app must answer both by 12 January 2027, and any update or questionnaire change before then must include them. Dating features mean a minimum rating of 18+.

APPLE-DEVELOPER-ID-SUBCA-EXPIRY-2027.title: Re-sign Mac installers before old certificates expire
APPLE-DEVELOPER-ID-SUBCA-EXPIRY-2027.summary: The original Developer ID certificate authority expires on 1 February 2027, and certificates it issued stop working that day. Before then, create a new Developer ID certificate from the Developer ID Certification Authority (G2) and re-sign every installer package you distribute outside the Mac App Store.

GOOGLE-JAPAN-PAYMENTS-AUTHORIZATION-2026.title: Complete the Japan payments form in Play Console
GOOGLE-JAPAN-PAYMENTS-AUTHORIZATION-2026.summary: If you sell into or out of Japan, complete the payments authorization form in Play Console by 1 December 2026. If you don't, Google holds your payments worldwide.

GOOGLE-SUBSCRIPTION-ELIGIBILITY-DISCOUNT.title: Explain the rules for student and similar discounts
GOOGLE-SUBSCRIPTION-ELIGIBILITY-DISCOUNT.summary: If a subscription has an ongoing discount people must qualify for, like a student plan, clearly say who qualifies, how you check, and what the price and benefits are once they no longer qualify.

GOOGLE-APPFUNCTIONS-POLICY-2027.title: Rules for app features AI agents can use
GOOGLE-APPFUNCTIONS-POLICY-2027.summary: If your app exposes AppFunctions (features AI agents can use), it must follow every Play policy. Those functions must not deceive or manipulate AI agents, get around security controls, or interfere with other apps.

GOOGLE-LOCAL-NETWORK-MANAGE-CONTACTS-202.title: Declare Local Network and Manage Contacts permissions
GOOGLE-LOCAL-NETWORK-MANAGE-CONTACTS-202.summary: Only use Local Network or Manage Contacts for core features where built-in pickers fall short. Both need a Play Console declaration, for Local Network if you target Android 17 (API 37) or higher. Otherwise switch to narrower built-in requests (platform intents).

CN-CAC-MINOR-PLATFORM-FILING-2026.title: Apps with many minor users must file
CN-CAC-MINOR-PLATFORM-FILING-2026.summary: If your app has 10 million or more registered, or 1 million or more monthly active, minor users, or significant impact on minors, file designation materials and a self-assessment report with the provincial cyberspace office by around 16 November 2026. Apps aimed at minors: 10 million registered and 1 million monthly active users. The designation committee will tell qualifying non-filers to file.

ID-PP-TUNAS-SELF-ASSESSMENT-2026.title: Finish a child-safety check for every feature
ID-PP-TUNAS-SELF-ASSESSMENT-2026.summary: Every company running an app or online service (electronic system operator) must finish the child-protection self-assessment for each product, service and feature by 31 December 2026. If a product misses that date, Indonesia's digital ministry (Kemkomdigi) says it can label it high-risk directly, which brings the stricter high-risk obligations.

KR-PIPA-AI-DATA-REUSE-2027.title: When you can reuse personal data for AI
KR-PIPA-AI-DATA-REUSE-2027.summary: From 9 March 2027, you can reuse personal data collected lawfully for another purpose to develop AI, but only when removing or masking identities would make that hard, it serves a public interest or similar purpose, all legal requirements are met, and the Personal Information Protection Commission reviews and decides on it. Before using this route, assess the risks to users.

APPLE-MIN-DEPLOYMENT-TARGET-IOS13.title: Apps must target iOS 13 or later
APPLE-MIN-DEPLOYMENT-TARGET-IOS13.summary: Any iOS or iPadOS app you upload to App Store Connect must target iOS 13 or later, and this already applies. The pre-submission check flags a lower deployment target (IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET) or Podfile platform.
